column7: Closes the task store's gate for a new restart attempt, with its deadline and backstop; refuses (Unavailable) unless the gate is open
Certifies the task store for a restart attempt only after admitted work settles and every record is re-saved; otherwise answers the floor fault that cancels the restart
Re-saves every loaded task record under the ordering lock without closing the store; refuses a store that is not ready and stops once its attempt is superseded
Cancel recovery: reopens the task store's gate (parked work first) and supersedes a running re-save
A stop signal won: releases the task store's gate so parked work completes, and supersedes a running re-save
The commit edge: new external task-store writes are refused from here; parked and internal work proceed
Decides whether a new restart attempt may start: false while a resumed cohort drains or an earlier re-save still runs
Builds the adapter with no attempt and the stop budget that sets every attempt's backstop; a wrong budget moves when parked internal work proceeds
